scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ariadne/protocol && npm run build --workspace @ariadne/runtime && npm run build --workspace @ariadne/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @ariadne/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace @ariadne/runtime && npm run typecheck --workspace @ariadne/app
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @ariadne/protocol && npm run build --workspace @ariadne/runtime && npm run test --workspace @ariadne/protocol && npm run test --workspace @ariadne/runtime && npm run test --workspace @ariadne/app
scripts.test:electron: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/electron-smoke.ps1
